scope: All 60 confirmation messages independently annotated from customer text before candidate predictions; routing_dev labels were used only to identify schema and allowed sentiment values.

coverage.absent_intent_explanation: No confirmation message is non-English; all 11 English-domain taxonomy intents are represented.

review_notes: These are AI labels, not human labels or a claim of human acceptance.
Payment-detail failures and paid-but-Free complaints follow billing precedence; security evidence overrides access.
Actual account access and individual eligibility failures escalate; first-contact general plan guidance remains auto-handle when the issue is described.
Self-troubleshooting, recurring bugs, and repeated access failures are not assumed to be repeated support contact.
Linked media and prior conversations were not opened or inferred. Unexplained media, DM-only text, and undetailed venting are treated conservatively.
High frustration is judged from the whole message; mild frustration, emphasis, and temporary fallback are not automatically treated as churn.
The low_confidence reason is model-specific and was not invented from unobserved model confidence during annotation.
Coverage is descriptive; this English sample cannot validate the non_english class.
